It’s clear from the overwhelming support in the UN that the world is ready for reparations.

When I was in Congress, I introduced historic legislation to hold the federal government accountable for its role in the Trans-Atlantic slave trade, address systemic racism, and close the racial wealth gap.

When I’m back, I’ll keep fighting for a holistic reparations program to address the ongoing legacies of chattel slavery, Jim Crow, and present-day anti-Black policies.

Let’s Go Cards!


St. Louis Cardinals (@Cardinals)

It starts now.

I had such a great time on 314 Day this year!

But if you know me, you know that I celebrate St. Louis every day of the year.

And when I’m back in Congress, I’ll go right back to fighting for us in DC to make sure that we get the housing, education, and healthcare that our families deserve.

Video

Thank you so much to Central Baptist Church for inviting me to join you in celebrating your 180th anniversary!

I had a great time celebrating your history, the community you’ve built, and the amazing people who make the congregation special.

Here’s to many more years of lifting spirits and transforming lives here in St. Louis.

I was honored to share the stage last night with @ibramxk to talk about the ideas shaping the political moment we’re in now and how to fight back against authoritarianism.

It was so incredible to hear his insights as we discussed his new book, Chain of Ideas, with community members in St. Louis County.

I can’t wait to bring this knowledge with me to Congress to serve St. Louis as we stand up to this president’s agenda.

Thanks so much to @novelneighbor for putting it all together!

The differences between me and the incumbent in this race are clear:

I’ve never taken millions from corporations, special interests, and Donald Trump’s biggest donors.

I’m not afraid to fight back against Trump’s attacks on our democracy, vote for him to be impeached, and call for ICE to be abolished.

When I’m back in Congress, I’ll keep leading in the fights that matter and delivering record federal funding to St. Louis.

Eid Mubarak to our Muslim community here in St. Louis and to all those who celebrate around the world.

This Ramadan has been incredibly difficult, especially for those with family in Palestine, Lebanon, and Iran. Even amidst the violence and suffering, I’m hoping that this Eid can bring you joy. I pray for an end to war, oppression, and injustice and for a future of peace and liberation.

I’m wishing you and your loved ones safety and resilience today and always.

I’m running a campaign by and for the people of St. Louis.

Together, we’ll build a brighter future and win a St. Louis where our families can thrive.

As Democrats, we should be using our power to fight for everyday people.

Far too often, corporate interests, billionaires, and right-wing lobbies come between politicians and the people who we have the responsibility to represent.

But we’re running a different kind of campaign.

Because I don’t take any money from the cryptocurrency PACs, Big Pharma, or other corporations, I can truly represent the people of St. Louis and bring our values back to Congress.

Join us at coribush.org

Video

Happy St. Patrick’s Day, St. Louis!

Two years ago, I was honored to represent St. Louis while spending the holiday with then Minister of State, now Minister of Culture, Communications and Sport, Patrick O’Donovan, and other visitors from the Republic of Ireland.

If you know me, you know I never miss an opportunity to show the world how we do things in STL. Wishing everyone a wonderful celebration today. 💚☘️

The Trump administration’s oil embargo on Cuba has now shut down the nation's power grid, resulting in a humanitarian crisis for over ten million people.

Utilities, hospitals, and other critical infrastructure have ceased to function, putting countless lives at risk.

This is a senseless, vindictive act of economic warfare by President Trump. Congress must act now to end his embargo and stop this preventable crisis.

Help us grow the movement!

We’re calling supporters and inviting them to get involved with Team Cori. Join our Volunteer Recruitment Phonebank and help us build the people-powered campaign that will win.

Sign up at mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

The political moment we’re in right now is different from 2 years ago. And it demands that we fight harder than ever.

This election, voters know what the incumbent in this race is really about, and what his priorities are. More people are familiar with AIPAC and other right-wing lobbies and how they influence our elections.

St. Louis deserves a fighter who will do everything they can for everyday people, even when it’s hard, and when corporate PACs and special interests don’t like it.

I had a great time spending another 314 Day out and about across St. Louis!

Days like this remind us why we do this work in the first place: delivering for the people who make STL great.

I’m so proud to be running to represent this special place and its amazing community in Congress.

Together, we’ll fight the St. Louis that we deserve where our families are safe and healthy and where we can all thrive.

Join me next weekend in Florissant as we continue growing the momentum we need to win Missouri’s 1st Congressional District.

Together, our movement will bring the values of everyday St. Louisans to Washington as we fight for quality healthcare, good jobs, and the education that our children deserve.

But we need your help — this movement doesn’t move without you.

Join me, volunteers, and supporters on Sunday, March 22nd, for our Meet and Greet Fundraiser at 18 Grandview Plaza in Florissant as

Today, on 314 Day, I’m reflecting on what makes St. Louis great:

The culture, the food, the music, the people, and our resilience.

I’m so proud to be from here and to run for Congress to fight for what our district needs.

Our community deserves so much better than what we are getting right now, from jobs, to healthcare, to housing, and more.

Together, we’ll build a St. Louis for everyone that we all can afford.
